The two-axis block — every progress curve

Exps 135–151 · BnOH · 25 °C · pyrophosphate · 119 cuvettes

All 119 cuvettes of exps 135–151 — BnOH, 25 °C, pyrophosphate — in pH order, from 5.47 to 9.73. The rust line is whichever form the curve earned, one relaxation or two, from summary_kinetics.fit_progress; the blue dashed vertical is where the rolling slope peaks, which is where v_max is read. Nothing is excluded and every fit uses every point except the instrument's first reading, which is discarded from every run in the archive.

9 of 119 curves are not live and are drawn anyway, all of them at the bottom of the pH ladder. Below them sit the runs marked weak run — exps 136, 137, 147, 149, 150 — whose own cuvettes do not predict their own rates (scope.concentration_agreement below 0.70). Section 3 and section 4 are measured without them; section 2 is measured with them, and says what changes.
